card.name: Start of brand names after treatment
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of an uppercase brand drug name right after words like "treated with", "receiving" or "discontinuation of". Also fires on the first digit of a percentage in adverse-event counts.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: First piece of a capitalized brand name split into pieces after a treatment phrase.

modes.label: Leading digit of a percentage
modes.description: The first digit of an incidence percentage in safety statements.
